prompt:
Implement `src/VcfAutomationClient.java` as a single-file Java 17 client using only the standard library. Preserve `VcfAutomationClient(URI baseUri, String basicAuthorization, String refreshToken)`, `DeploymentResult(String projectId, String catalogItemId, String deploymentId)`, and `deploy(projectName, catalogItemName, deploymentName)`.

Before implementing, research `exchangeRefreshToken`, `getProjects`, `getCatalogItems`, and `requestCatalogItemInstances` in the official Broadcom VCF Automation xAPIs reference. Confirm their methods, paths, parameters, request and response schemas, status codes, and authentication requirements, and cite the official sources consulted in the final answer.

`deploy` must:

1. Exchange the configured refresh token with `POST /oidc/oauth2/token`. Send the constructor's complete Basic authorization value, `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, and a percent-encoded form containing only `grant_type=refresh_token` and `refresh_token=<configured token>`. Retain the returned `access_token`.
2. Resolve the project with `GET /iaas/api/projects`, sending a single `$filter` query value of `name eq '<projectName>'`. Require exactly one exact-name match and retain its returned `id`.
3. Resolve the catalog item with `GET /catalog/api/items`, sending `search=<catalogItemName>` and `projects=<returned project id>`. Require exactly one exact-name match and retain its returned `id`.
4. Request the item with `POST /catalog/api/items/{returned catalog item id}/request` and a JSON body containing only `deploymentName` and `projectId`, using the project id returned by this invocation. Require exactly one response entry with a nonblank `deploymentId`, and return all three ids in `DeploymentResult`.

Every operation after token exchange carries `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` and `Accept: application/json`; the catalog request also carries `Content-Type: application/json`. The first catalog lookup returns HTTP 401 after the token expires. Exchange the refresh token again and replay that identical lookup with the new bearer token, preserving the already resolved project id and unchanged query. Do not restart the workflow or repeat a successful operation. Preserve interruption semantics, fail clearly on other non-success responses or malformed results, and never expose either credential in an error.

Change only `src/VcfAutomationClient.java`. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`.
